summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial ## Introduction Welcome to the Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial. In this video, we will guide you through the essential sewing simulation techniques using the software. ## Creating Sewing Lines ### Line Sewing Tool To create a sewing line between two lines, use the line sewing tool: 1. Click on one line and then click on another line. 2. A set of sewing lines will be displayed in the same color. ### Direction of Sewing Lines During the sewing process, it is crucial to pay attention to the direction of the sewing line. The blade shape on the sewing line indicates the direction sign. ### Symmetrical Sewing Lines Upon completing a set of sewing lines, a symmetrical sewing line will also appear on the symmetrical board. If the sewing line points in the opposite direction, you can change its direction. ## Adjusting Sewing Lines ### Edge Sewing Line Tool To select a sewing line, use the edge sewing line tool. In the menu located in the right-hand corner, choose the option to change the sewing line. This will ensure that the sewing line is no longer crossed and that the direction is the same. ### Free Sewing Tool If there is a cut in the sewing line, use the free sewing tool: 1. After selecting the free sewing tool, click the start position and then the end position. 2. The same method applies to the other side. ### Completing Sewing Lines Pay attention to the direction in which the sewing line is created and click both ends to complete the creation of other sewing lines. ## Simulating on the Model ### Adjustment Board Tool After completing the sewing lines, return to the adjustment board tool. - Click the model button to have the clothing worn on the model, simulating the weight and function of the sewing line in the 3D environment. ### Dragging Points While the machine is simulated, click and drag a point on the clothing. This allows you to drag the clothing as you would in the real world. After your adjustments, you can close the simulation. ## Modifying Sewing Lines ### Opening the Clothing If the side of the clothing needs to be opened, modify the sewing line: 1. Click with the edge sewing line tool. 2. Use the sewing line tool to click and drag one end of the sewing line. 3. Repeat the same process on the other side. ### Visualizing Changes The blue line on the sewing line marks the position equal to its length. Once you open the simulation, you can observe that the side of the clothing will have an opening effect. ## Finalizing the Simulation After completing the simulation adjustments, you can again click and drag points on the clothing as needed. ## Checking Particle Diameter To check the particle diameter: 1. Select all the panels and right-click. 2. In the 3D view menu, select the display grid to examine the layout of the clothing grid. ### Grid Types You will notice that the default grid type is a triangular grid. When the grid is larger, the folds of the clothing may not be detailed enough. To enhance detail: - Select all panels and reduce the particle diameter to 10. This will result in more detailed folds as the grid becomes smaller. ## Changing the Grid Type In the attribute editor, you can change the grid type to a square. After opening the grid, verify that the grid type of the clothing is indeed not a square. ### Resetting the Grid After selecting the clothing, right-click, and you will find a reset grid option in the menu. The grid will be neat after the reset. ## Using the Select Grid Tool When using the select grid tool, you will see a neat 2D window. This tool allows for effective selection and adjustment of the grid. ## Conclusion Thank you for following along with this tutorial. We hope you found these tips useful for your sewing simulation in Marvelous Designer. ```
